text:
Mia: Heads-up — canary shows a sharp token/sec collapse on continuous-batcher after the last release merge. Observed ~30-40% drop, queueing delays spike. Should we hold the rollout?
Omar: Reproduced locally on staging with the load harness. Drop kicks in during warmup when KV backfill starts; small batches multiply. Quick log sample:
```
WARN scheduler: worker=ctb-7 drain_time_ms=28 batch_size=5 tokens/sec=1280 -> 760 queue_delay_ms=42
INFO kvcache: backfill=active hitrate=0.12
```
Raj: Narrowing commits — last green d4f5e7, first bad is merge abc123 (title: "scheduler: packing heuristic + kernel-hint alignment"). I'll kick a bisect perf job across that range. Can someone queue the CI perf run with the token/sec burn?
perf-bot: perf CI queued: https://ci.internal.redwood/bench/4321 — initial comparison shows ~38% tokens/sec regression vs baseline on the same infra.
Lina: Profile snapshot points at an unexpected memcpy hotspot when kernel-fallback kicks in. Kernel selection path toggles memcpy-heavy copy for small tensors:
```
# perf snippet
samples  flat  name
45       12.4% memcpy
18        4.8% kernel_fallback
```
Ben: Hypothesis: packing heuristic is producing many thin batches during warmup, which forces kernel-fallback (memcopy path) more often. That overhead dominates for short sequences. Try disabling packing for the warmup window? Config override I tested quickly:
```
continuous_batcher:
  packing_enabled: false
  warmup_seq_threshold: 8
```
Omar: Applied packing_enabled=false to the canary subset — token/sec climbed back to ~98% of baseline in our synthetic warmup run. Latency tail unchanged. So this is actionable (either revert the packing change or gate it behind rollout flag).
Mia: Hold the rollout for the whole canary fleet. Opening a revert/feature-gate PR and adding a targeted perf test to catch this in CI. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/2891
Raj: I'll run a longer bisect with sustained token burn and add a regression test that simulates KV backfill during warmup. Assigning to me + Omar to craft the fix. Add to incident timeline if hold lasts >1h.
perf-bot: deploybot: rollout paused for canary group "ctb-canary-3" by Mia :no_entry_sign:
